note: Rulings for scripts/check_file_ops.py (Commandment 7). A ruling is only for a file Probanda created, or for a step that routes through file-manager. A ruling covers exactly "count" lines of its file with its operation, each one read and of the case its note describes. Reasons: own-output = a document, page or folder Probanda rendered or copied; temp = a temp or scratch file or folder Probanda made for the run, or its own lock; own-database = a database, dump, store, config or credential file Probanda keeps; own-overlay = a file in a skill's knowledge overlay (_fetched, _superseded); own-run = a session or run folder Probanda keeps for one workflow; conditional = routes through file-manager and stops without it; mention = names the operation without telling anyone to do it to a file.

One rmSync, in removeOwn, which deletes each entry of the folder but lease.json first and then the folder, so a folder a delete error leaves part-way keeps its lease and is swept again; reached two ways, each a host-local folder this server made: an ingest run's folder under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Coclerk\ingest-runs (its lease.json, journal.jsonl and dispatches) more than 30 days after the run ended or last beat: one whose lease names the matter that folder is keyed on is checked again under that matter's run lock and kept while any of its page images remain, and one whose lease names no matter, or another folder's, is removed without that lock; and, at a run's end, that folder's dispatches subfolder of stored extractor inputs.

In writeLease: the lease.tmp this server has just written in an ingest run's own folder under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Coclerk\ingest-runs is renamed over that folder's lease.json, so the lease is written whole or not at all. In adoptOldLayout: a run an older build left directly in its matter folder there (its journal.jsonl, dispatches, lease.tmp and lease.json, each by that exact name) moves into a legacy-<started> folder beside it.

In removeImageFolder, at a run's end or when its folder is swept: each page image the renderer wrote for a bridged dispatch, named page-NNNN.png or page-NNNN-tile-N.png (four digits or more), in a 16-hex per-PDF folder of an ingest-<dispatch_id> folder under <matter_root>\0. CASE DATA\Page images, the dispatch id from that run folder's own journal. Any other file there is left alone.

In removeImageFolder: the per-PDF folder, then the ingest-<dispatch_id> folder, each only once it is empty, so a folder holding a file Probanda did not write stays. In sweep: a matter folder under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Coclerk\ingest-runs, which holds only run folders this server made, once the last of them is gone and only if it is empty.

Deletes an extractor result this tool staged in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Coclerk\extract-results: in stageResult, one staged more than 7 days ago; in dropStagedResults, at an ingest run's end, each privileged or affidavit-exhibit result that a write in the matter's run-folder journal names (every run that journal records, not only the one ending), so privileged wording kept for a question still open, and an exhibit reading the reply's cap held back, does not wait out the 7-day window.

Deletes a result staged by matter_data__stage_result in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Coclerk\extract-results once ingest_result is done with it: a privileged result on every definite outcome (kept on an open question, and on an error a repeat of the call needs), an exhibit's result written pending a privilege decision, and a reading refused because its document may be privileged, so privileged wording does not wait out the 7-day window (ingest orchestrator spec 2.1).
